subject: world_language
concept: Describing something that already happened using simple past tense in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'describe past experiences' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student performs an action, then describes it a moment later using the target-language past-tense form
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a past-tense sentence to the picture showing the completed action
exercise.abstract: Student writes a sentence describing something that happened yesterday in the target language

misconception_flags: uses present-tense form instead of the correct past-tense form

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
